The main takeaway from our work is that
CM voltages induced at the terminals of the interconnection are directly related to the bulk current injected by the probe.
CM voltages can be accurately predicted by the probe model and that the probe model can be simplified for the purpose of predicting DM voltages.
the BCI Standards, which are currently based on the assumption of perfectly balanced terminations, can be extended to the case of unbalanced terminations.
